# PDF Toolkit Pro - Full Documentation & Tool Reference

> Comprehensive API, workflow, and feature reference for PDF Toolkit Pro (https://pdftoolkitpro.online).

PDF Toolkit Pro is a client-side, privacy-first PDF and document manipulation suite designed to handle PDF editing, conversions, compression, security, OCR, and AI document workflows directly inside the user's browser.

## Privacy Architecture
- **Zero Server Uploads for Standard Tools**: PDF manipulation (editing, merging, splitting, rotating, watermarking, signing) runs locally in client WebAssembly and JavaScript engines.
- **Auto-Deletion of Temporary Files**: Any server-side conversions or OCR workflows are processed in ephemeral memory sandboxes and permanently deleted immediately after processing.

## Complete List of Available Tools

### 1. Online PDF Editor
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/online-pdf-editor
- **Capabilities**: Add text with 29+ Unicode fonts (including Arabic, Devanagari, Hebrew, Thai, Cyrillic, Greek, Japanese), freehand drawing, geometric shapes, signature stamps, image overlay, whiteout, text redaction, and multi-page reorganizing.

### 2. Merge PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/merge-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Reorder, drag-and-drop, and merge unlimited PDF files into a single unified document with vector fidelity.

### 3. Split PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/split-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Extract custom page ranges, split by individual page, or extract odd/even pages.

### 4. Compress PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/compress-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Reduce PDF file size with selectable compression levels (Extreme, Recommended, High Quality).

### 5. Rotate PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/rotate-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Visual interactive grid to rotate individual or all pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°.

### 6. Delete PDF Pages
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/delete-pdf-pages
- **Capabilities**: Select and delete individual or multiple pages with real-time rendered thumbnail previews.

### 7. Reorder PDF Pages
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/reorder-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Drag-and-drop page reorganization with instant export.

### 8. Protect & Encrypt PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/protect-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Add user password and owner permissions encryption (copying, printing restrictions).

### 9. Unlock PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/unlock-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Decrypt password-protected PDF files to remove restrictions.

### 10. Add Watermark
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/watermark-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Text watermarks with opacity, rotation, font size, and color adjustments or image watermark overlay.

### 11. Sign PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/sign-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Electronic signature generation via stylus/finger drawing, custom typed calligraphy, or uploaded PNG signatures.

### 12. OCR PDF (Optical Character Recognition)
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/ocr-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Extract searchable and copyable text from scanned PDFs and photos across English, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, and 20+ other languages.

### 13. Word Document Editor
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/word-editor
- **Capabilities**: Full browser-based rich text editor supporting formatting, headings, lists, tables, and export to DOCX/PDF.

### 14. Excel Spreadsheet Editor
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/excel-editor
- **Capabilities**: Multi-sheet grid editor with formula evaluation (SUM, AVERAGE, VLOOKUP, IF, etc.), cell styling, filtering, and XLSX export.

### 15. PDF to Word (DOCX)
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/pdf-to-word
- **Capabilities**: Convert PDF text and layout into editable Microsoft Word DOCX files.

### 16. PDF to Excel (XLSX)
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/pdf-to-excel
- **Capabilities**: Detect table structures inside PDF files and convert them into structured XLSX worksheets.

### 17. Passport Photo Maker
- **URL**: https://pdftoolkitpro.online/tools/passport-photo
- **Capabilities**: Crop images to standard US (2x2 inch), India, UK, Schengen passport sizes with background replacement.
